# Model card: churn-model v2

*Generated 2026-01-01 from MLflow run `cab1ecb8`. Do not edit by hand; edit the context file and regenerate.*

## Overview
churn-model version 2 scores AUC 0.973 (95% interval 0.969 to 0.977) on a held-out set.

## Intended use
Rank existing customers by churn risk so the retention team can prioritise outreach.

### Out of scope
- Credit, pricing or eligibility decisions about individual customers.
- Customers outside the markets present in the training data.

## Training data
Synthetic customer-behaviour data generated by this repository (6 numeric features, 2 subgroups). No real personal data.

## Training procedure
| parameter | value |
|---|---|
| C | 1.0 |
| n_features | 6 |
| note | full data |
| seed | 0 |

## Evaluation
Held-out set of 4000 examples.

| metric | value | 95% interval |
|---|---|---|
| AUC | 0.973 | 0.969 to 0.977 |
| Expected calibration error | 0.007 | 0.007 to 0.007 |

### Performance by subgroup
| subgroup | n | AUC |
|---|---|---|
| overall | 4000 | 0.973 |
| group 0 | 2787 | 0.970 |
| group 1 | 1213 | 0.979 |

Largest subgroup gap: **0.009** AUC.

## Limitations and risks
- Trained and evaluated on synthetic data; performance on real customers is unknown.
- Subgroup 1 contains a feature interaction that the linear model only partly captures.

## Changes since v1
- parameter `note`: small baseline -> full data
- AUC: 0.962 -> 0.973
